defect: The Linux xterm run found that the Location menu assigned B to both Go back and Add bookmark. The keyboard invoked Go back and did not save a bookmark.
fix: The Location menu and command catalog assign D to Add bookmark. The application regression sends Alt+L, D and verifies the second bookmark in the left-pane picker, reopens it through the dialog and checks that the right pane is unchanged.
open: Current Linux suite and two-process xterm bookmark persistence
Current Windows build and ordinary-user acceptance
